# what is a dataframe?


```{python}
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "a": [4, 5, 6],
    "b": [7, 8, 9],
    "c": [10, 11, 12]
})
df
```

Can you tell what its doing?


```{python}
df = pl.from_numpy(
    np.array([
        [4, 5, 6],
        [7, 8, 9],
        [10, 11, 12]
    ]),
    schema=['a', 'b', 'c']
)
df
```



# Subset parts of data



## rename a column


```{python}
df = df.rename({'Life expectancy (years)':'life_yrs'})
df
```

```{python}
df.filter(pl.col('Year') > 1999)
df.filter(pl.col('Year') <= 2000), pl.col('Year') >= 2000
```


```{python}
# drop function
df.drop(pl.col('Code'))
df
```
